thread.document:
Hey everyone, 

My group worked on refactoring the RNN & Gradient Flow notebook (HW7 Q1) for Special Participation C. We focussed on adding more context throughout the notebook. Every class now has docstrings explaining what it does and why it matters. More importantly, we included the actual math formulations right next to the code as well as diagrams showing RNN unrolling and multi-layer architectures.

We worked reorganizing the code structure. Helper functions like generate_batch, train, and train_all now live in a separate utils.py file, and all test cases have been moved to tests.py to remove clutter and  .

On the style side, we cleaned up variable names, added type hints so you know exactly what tensor shapes to expect, and fixed the indentation to follow PEP 8 guidelines.

Here's a link to my GitHub repo containing the refactored notebook:

https://github.com/adalal07/cs182-special-participation-c1

Hope it's helpful!

CC: Arnav Dalal, Kabir Shah
